description: Arrêts, horaires et circuits des lignes de transports en commun en Pays de la Loire (GTFS Destinéo : réseaux AOM + Aléop) is a dataset listed in Open Data Région Pays de la Loire, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Destinéo. Arrêts des lignes de transports en commun en Pays de la Loire (GTFS complet) Horaires théoriques LISTE DES RESEAUX: ALEOP (transport régional en Pays de la Loire) - TAN (Nantes) - IRIGO (Angers) - IMPULSYON (La Roche-sur-Yon) - CARENE (CARENE) - SETRAM (Le Mans) - CHOLETBUS (Cholet) - SNCF (TER) - LILAPRESQUILE (Cap Atlantique) - ... Coverage: Pays de la Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are ALEOP, TAN, IRIGO, IMPULSYON, CARENE, SETRAM. The portal shows 3 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2022-05-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-paysdelaloire-fr-portal.
